locale.description: The language of the deck the lines were written for; null when the client did not say.

ahead.description: Reads that finish before this one is read: 0 once it is being read.

error.description: Why a failed read failed: `cv_file_kind`, `cv_file_unreadable`, `generation_limit` (more pages than any CV is made from, failed as it is uploaded and never read), `source_extraction_failed`, `read_timeout`, `file_unavailable`, `reader_interrupted` or `reader_error`. A failed file is a file not read: the CV says so (`cv_unread`), or is `cv_file_unreadable` when nothing at all was read.

ocr_pages.description: Of them, pages read by OCR.

error.description: Why the last try failed: `render_deck_interrupted` is worth asking again, `pinned_asset_expired` is not until the picture is changed.

status.description: `none`: nothing has been asked for, or it has gone; POST asks. `queued` and `running`: a task will draw this version or a later one. `done`: `slides` are this version. `failed`: see `error`. `stale`: this version was not drawn and the deck has moved on.

key.description: What its picture is made from: the same key is the same picture.

device.description: The device that last changed it, as it named itself; empty when it did not.

cv_facts.description: A new CV (`ai.cv`): which of its facts the description and files give. `given` lists the facts found, `missing` the required ones not found (`name`, `contact`, `background`) and `optional_missing` the optional ones not found, each in the order of the feature's `cv_facts`. A draft made after the customer insisted can still have `missing` facts. Absent on a change.

cv_unread.description: A CV made from files (`ai.cv`): each file not read whole, with how many of its pages were left out; `whole` when none of it was read. Absent when everything was read.

render.description: A generated deck (`ai.pptx`): how it was drawn, so an edit changes only the slide it touches. `variants` and `photos` are by section id; a photo `asset_id` is the account's own file, null when none was kept, and `candidates` are small copies kept on offer for that slide, possibly none. `deck_seed` is opaque. Absent until a deck has been made.

per_command.description: What a send from the editor did with each change, once it has run.

index.description: Its position in the draft's `commands`, from 0.

status.description: `skipped`: its page was deleted in the same send.

rasterized_pages.description: The pages, numbered as uploaded, that became pictures in a send from the editor.

kind.description: `file_task`: this send uses one of the week's file tasks. `included`: the plan has no weekly limit. `none`: it uses nothing, as the same file already exists or is being made or, with `count_once` on, this draft has been counted this week.

left.description: File tasks left this week, before this send; null when `included`.

post.description: One draft per account and file: 201 for a new one, 200 with the marks already there for a file opened before. A file the editor cannot open is `unsupported_file`, with `message_params.reason` one of `password`, `signed`, `pptx_upload`, `not_pdf` when it is known. A file of this account that has run out is `file_expired` (410); one the customer deleted, is unknown or belongs to another account is `file_unavailable` (404).

410.description: `file_expired`: the file has run out and has to be sent again.

400.description: Invalid request. `invalid_editor_command`: one change cannot be saved. `message_params` has `index`, its position in `commands` counted from 0, and `code`, why it was refused. Nothing is saved.

409.description: `version_conflict`: the draft changed elsewhere. `message_params` has `updated_at`, `device` and the marks each side holds, `theirs` and `mine`. Nothing is saved.

413.description: `payload_too_large`: the draft measures over `limits.bytes`, or the body over 128 KiB. Nothing is saved.

post.description: One send of the stored draft: one quote, one job, one file task. The marks are read again at submission and when the job runs; if they have changed since, that is `version_conflict` and nothing is counted. A send identical to the last file made, or to the one being made, returns that job rather than a new one.

deliver.description: Where the file goes: this is a send of the stored draft, by a pointer to it. The Quote holds no marks and comes with `summary`. Left out by the web from before these sends, whose quote carries the marks.

400.description: `rasterization_consent_required`: pages would become pictures and `accept_rasterization` was not true; `message_params.pages` lists them. `editor_text_overflow`: a text does not fit its page; `message_params.index` is its position in `commands`, counted from 0. `invalid_editor_command`, as on saving. Nothing is quoted.

409.description: `version_conflict`: the draft changed elsewhere. `message_params` has `updated_at`, `device` and `theirs`, the marks it holds now; the request carries no marks, so the client counts its own. `telegram_link_required`: `deliver` is `chat` and the account has no Telegram. Nothing is quoted.

429.description: `weekly_file_limit`: this week's file tasks are used up. `send_limit`: too many sends for now, `retryable`; `message_params` has `limit` and `per`, `day` for this draft or `hour` for the account. Nothing is quoted.

cv_read.description: Only for `purpose` `cv_source`: the file is queued for reading as it arrives, and this is how its read stands.

parameters.description: One byte range: `bytes=0-99`, `bytes=100-` or `bytes=-500`. Several ranges, anything ill-formed, or an `If-Range` header answer with the whole file and 200.

413.description: `payload_too_large`: a deck draft body over 128 KiB (other drafts: `invalid_request` over 32 KiB). Nothing is saved.

post.description: The price of sending a generated deck again from its draft, as PowerPoint, PDF or both: no AI edit, one file task, submitted through `/jobs`. It holds nothing of the deck but ids and the format. Refused, with status 409, when: `version_conflict`; `generation_running`; `deck_not_editable` (not a deck, or none has been drawn from this draft yet); `pinned_asset_expired` (`message_params.sections`: [{id, index}], the slides whose picture is no longer stored); `slide_text_too_long` (`message_params.sections`: [{id, index, words_over}], the slides whose text would not all show).

How one slide as it stands in the editor sits on this deck, and the layouts that would hold it whole. Nothing is saved or drawn into a file. A section whose id the deck does not have is measured as a slide added at the end. `deck_not_editable` as for the export quote.

get.description: How the drawing of this version of the deck stands; the draft's current one without `version`. Reads only. Answers `feature_unavailable` with the deck editor off.

post.description: Have this version of the deck drawn, in a queue of its own and free, when a field is committed: not on every autosave. A newer ask replaces one still queued. Only the slides that changed are drawn. `version_conflict`; `deck_not_editable`; `lane_busy` (429, retryable) past the day's budget or with three tasks waiting.

A deck's slide count and design, or a CV's template, chosen over what its description says. A deck (`ai.pptx`) takes `pages` and `deck_design` (a design id or `auto`); a CV (`ai.cv`) takes `cv_template` (a template id or `auto`); anything else is refused. Returns the new quote; the review in the Telegram chat is redrawn with it.

get.description: A slide already drawn, 1280 by 720 px, inline. Nothing is drawn for this request: anything else is 404.
A slide already drawn, 96 by 54 px, inline. Nothing is drawn for this request: anything else is 404.

post.description: Review a fresh quote for an unchanged failed generation. Completed provider batches may be reused only within this explicit retry chain; confirmation and allowance checks still apply.

Returns 200 on identical retry, and for a send of a draft that already made this very file or is making it, with that job and with its file kept another 24 hours. Same key with changed quote returns 409, and so does a quote already sent under another key (`quote_already_submitted`). `telegram_link_required` (409) when the result is to go to a chat and the account has no Telegram; `send_limit` (429, retryable) when a draft has been sent too often. A failed black-out check is a job failed with `editor_check_failed`, `error.message_params.index` naming the change, and is not counted.

delete.description: Takes files the customer removed from a CV out of the reading queue: their reads still queued are dropped. A read already started finishes; ids that are gone or not the account's are passed over. A file dropped here and used after all is queued again when a draft asks for it.

get.description: How the reading of a CV's files stands. A file uploaded with `purpose` `cv_source` is read once, in a queue the accounts take turns in, never while a draft is made: a CV draft (`ai.cv`, `cv_source` `linkedin` or `file`) whose files are still queued or being read is refused with `cv_reading` (409; `message_params.ahead` and `estimated_seconds` as here), to be made again once they are read. `ids` names the account's own files, at most ten; an id that is no live file of theirs is `file_unavailable` (404). A file with no read yet is queued. `ahead` is how many reads of other customers' files finish before the first of these still queued is read (the account's own files are not ahead of it): 0 when none waits or one of them is being read; each read's own `ahead` counts every read before that file. `estimated_seconds` is about how long until the last is read, counting what is left of the reads in progress: 0 when none waits, null with no recent reads to tell it from or while no reader is taking the queued reads. Asked every two seconds or so while waiting; more than 120 in an account's minute (counted from its first request) is `rate_limited`.
Every template a CV can wear, grouped by category, in the colours each renders in. `locale` (en, uz, ru) names the categories; `default` is the template Auto starts from.
A template's page 1 with a fictional sample CV in `locale`, 480 px wide. Public and immutable: the catalogue's `preview` URL carries the catalogue's version.
Every design a deck can wear, grouped by category, in the colours each renders in. `locale` (en, uz, ru) names the categories.
A design's cover as the theme picker shows it, with a sample title in `locale`. Public and immutable: the catalogue's `preview` URL carries the design's version.
